name: 08088 · Southampton, NJ
findings: ZIP 08088 (Southampton) has 86 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 32 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08088 (Southampton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
